implementationSummary: Added read-only workspace change inspection module and MCP tool registration.
Implemented structured git status, summary, file entries, classifications, risk hints, bounded patch excerpts, and boundary fields.
Implemented secret-like file/content safety behavior with redaction and no-content excerpts for known secret files.
reportCorrections: DeepSeek reported bridge commit f45054e, but implementation was uncommitted at report time and was committed as 551d7af.
Observed module line count is 641 lines, while report described 501 compiled lines. Build passed.
caveats: Tool requires git available on the host.
Untracked file excerpts require cat available and fall back gracefully.
File classification uses path/name heuristics aside from secret detection in excerpts.
Tool requires bridge service/action refresh before it is visible to ChatGPT.
